question: Which of the following is a Kharif crop in North India and a Rabi crop in South India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sesamum.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Seasame is a** Rabi crop in South India.**
 
• It is a **flowering plant in the genus Sesamum and in India**, it is smaller in numbers.
 
• Another species of Sesamum is** S. Indicum**.
 
• Sesamum is also known as **Benne.**
 
• The mustard plant is a plant species in the **genera Brassica and Sinapis** in the family **Brassicaceae.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Finger millet (Ragi)**

 
 
• Millet is a collective term referring to a number of **small-seeded annual grasses that are cultivated as grain crops,** primarily on marginal lands in dry areas in** temperate, subtropical, and tropical regions.**
 
• Some of the common millets available in India are** Ragi (Finger millet), Jowar (Sorghum), Sama (Little millet), Bajra (Pearl millet), and Variga (Proso millet).**
 
 
 
• **Barley**
 
 
• Barley is cultivated as a rabi season crop in Rajasthan.
 
• It is sown in** October-December and harvested from March to May.**
 
 
 
• **Wheat**
 
 
• It is a Rabi crop generally sown between** October & November harvested between April & May.**
